$comment: USER-scope ~/.claude/settings.json fragment (not a project settings file). Keeps the GitNexus index on HEAD after git commands that move it. The hook body lives at ~/.claude/hooks/gitnexus-reindex-hook.sh, outside any repository, so repository contributors cannot change what runs in your session; it reads the tool call as JSON on stdin and never evaluates command text. Project-scope hooks are repo-controlled code and are not used for this.
